title.zh: 银河空间中的蒂亚尼基

excerpt.zh:
一只缇扬奇越过边境，进入了我国的[tiyanki_system.GetName]星系。由于缇扬奇已被宣布为星系害兽，任何境内有缇扬奇的星海共同体成员国都有法律义务确保这些生物被即刻消灭。

[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法，直至缇扬奇被处理掉或是自动离开我国境内为止。
excerpt.en: A Tiyanki pod has crossed into our space in the [tiyanki_system.GetName] system. As the Tiyanki have officially been declared galactic pests, all Galactic Community members are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any creatures present within their borders

scope.zh: 蒂亚尼基入境通知：舰队进入、决议通过、每月检查三种触发。
scope.en: Tiyanki inside borders notices: fleet entry, resolution enacted and monthly check.

label.zh: 同一违规通知的三个触发
label.en: Three triggers of the same breach notice

note.zh: 106：蒂亚尼基舰队进入国境（舰队事件 galcom.102）；104：决议“蒂亚尼基害虫防治”刚通过时已有蒂亚尼基在境内（galcom.103）；109：每月检查（galcom.108）发现。三者都设置 resolution_breached_tiyanki_inside_borders。
note.en: 106: a Tiyanki fleet enters borders (fleet event galcom.102); 104: when the resolution "Tiyanki Pest Control" passes with Tiyanki already inside (galcom.103); 109: found by the monthly check (galcom.108). All set resolution_breached_tiyanki_inside_borders.

texts.zh:
一只缇扬奇越过边境，进入了我国的[tiyanki_system.GetName]星系。由于缇扬奇已被宣布为星系害兽，任何境内有缇扬奇的星海共同体成员国都有法律义务确保这些生物被即刻消灭。

[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法，直至缇扬奇被处理掉或是自动离开我国境内为止。
texts.en:
A Tiyanki pod has crossed into our space in the [tiyanki_system.GetName] system. As the Tiyanki have officially been declared galactic pests, all Galactic Community members are legally obliged to immediately euthanize any creatures present within their borders.

The [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law until the Tiyanki have either departed our space or been exterminated.

label.zh: 这些害虫必须尽快处理。
label.en: This infestation must be dealt with.

texts.zh:
缇扬奇已被宣布为星系害兽。任何境内有缇扬奇的星海共同体成员国都有法律义务确保这些生物被即刻消灭。

不幸的是，我国境内就有缇扬奇存在。直至它们被处理掉或是自动离开我国境内为止，[Root.GetName]将被视为违反星系法。
texts.en:
The Tiyanki have officially been declared galactic pests. Any member of the Galactic Community with Tiyanki inside their borders are legally obliged to see to the immediate euthanization of the creatures.

Unfortunately, there are Tiyanki present within our space. Until they are dealt with, or they leave our space of their own accord, the [Root.GetName] will be considered in Breach of Galactic Law.

label.zh: 这些害虫必须尽快处理。
label.en: This infestation must be dealt with.

texts.zh: 星海共同体的官员注意到[Root.GetName]境内有缇扬奇存在。由于缇扬奇害兽管制议案已经生效，这使得我国处于违反星系法状态，直至这些生物被消灭或是自行主动离开为止。
texts.en: Officials from the Galactic Community have observed the presence of Tiyanki within the borders of the [Root.GetName]. With the Tiyanki Pest Control resolution having been enacted, this leaves us in Breach of Galactic Law until the creatures are euthanized or leave our space of their own accord.

label.zh: 这些害虫必须尽快处理。
label.en: This infestation must be dealt with.

summary.text:
# 缇扬奇进入[Root.GetSpeciesName]领土 / Tiyanki In [Root.GetSpeciesName] Space

- 分类 Category：文明纪事 Society (C7) · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13
- 来源 Sources：`events/galactic_community_events.txt:847-1159`；`common/resolutions/00_resolutions.txt:12809`；`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:115-116,1034`

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 决议“蒂亚尼基害虫防治”（resolution_tiyanki_pest_control）生效后，社群成员境内出现蒂亚尼基即违规：玩家可经三种途径收到通知——蒂亚尼基舰队进入系统（on_entering_system_fleet → galcom.102 → 106）、决议刚通过时已有（resolution effect → 103 → 104）、每月检查（on_monthly_pulse → galcom.108 → 109）。
  Once the resolution "Tiyanki Pest Control" is active, Tiyanki inside a member's borders is a breach, and the player is told in one of three ways: a Tiyanki fleet enters a system (on_entering_system_fleet -> galcom.102 -> 106), Tiyanki are already inside when the resolution passes (resolution effect -> 103 -> 104), or the monthly check (on_monthly_pulse -> galcom.108 -> 109).

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 三个窗口文字相似，选项按伦理分三种（中立 / 亲外 / 排外），都只确认情况。
  The three windows read alike and offer three ethic-based options (neutral / xenophile / xenophobe) that only acknowledge the situation.
- 每月清理事件 galcom.105 在蒂亚尼基离开后清除违规标志。
  The monthly clean-up event galcom.105 clears the breach flag once the Tiyanki leave.
- 另有 galcom.107 / 110（杀死蒂亚尼基违反法案：扣能量1000/5000）属于同一决议的惩罚线，未单列为故事。
  Galcom.107 / 110 (killing Tiyanki in violation: -1000 / -5000 energy) belong to the same resolutions' penalty line and are not separate stories.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 三种触发并行，视情形而定。
  The three triggers are parallel, by circumstance.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 选项按伦理而异。
  Options vary by ethics.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对：三条触发路径与清理事件。
  Checked: the three trigger paths and the clean-up event.
- 更正：103 和 108 原为各自孤立的故事，现并入。
  Correction: 103 and 108 were isolated stories; merged.
